Apply HSE-1 and map 2SN to EN 853 2SN.

Apply HSE-1 and map 4SH to EN 856 4SH.
Apply HSE-1 and map R13 to SAE 100R13.
Translate R2AT and 2SN separately, and never swap one for the other.
exceptions: Write CHECK: followed by a space and the original text when the hose standard is not in the picklist.

dash_size.written_form: Write the hose dash size as the dash designation from the hydraulic hose dash-size lookup table.
dash_size.not_listed: Write CHECK: followed by a space and the original text.
steps: Apply HSE-2 and look up an inch, mm, or DN value in the dash-size table.
Write the matching dash designation from the table, such as -8.
Map 1/2 in, 12.7 mm, DN12, or #8 to -8.
Write CHECK: followed by a space and the original text when no dash-size table entry matches.
exceptions: Write CHECK: followed by a space and the original text when the hose size cannot be found in the dash-size table.

max_working_pressure.written_form: Write the value as a whole number followed by one space and bar.
steps: Under HSE-3, convert psi by multiplying by 0.0689476 and convert MPa by multiplying by 10.
Round the result to a whole bar.
Write the metric result as a number followed by one space and bar.

end_fitting.written_form: Write the fitting as the corresponding canonical picklist value, preserving its capitalization, spaces, and symbols.
end_fitting.not_listed: Write CHECK: followed by a space and the original text.
steps: Under HSE-4, write JIC 37° Female Swivel for JIC female, JIC swivel, or 37 deg female.
Under HSE-4, write ORFS Female Swivel for ORFS female or O-ring face seal.
Under HSE-4, write BSPP Female Swivel for BSP female or BSPP female.
Under HSE-4, write NPT Male for NPT male or MNPT.
Under HSE-4, write Flange Code 61 for SAE 3000 flange or code 61.
Under HSE-4, write Flange Code 62 for SAE 6000 flange or code 62.

assembly_length.written_form: Write the assembly length as a whole number followed by one space and mm.
steps: Under HSE-5, convert metres to millimetres by multiplying by 1000.
Round the result to a whole millimetre.
Write the result as a number followed by one space and mm.

glove_size.written_form: Write the glove size as its EN ISO 21420 number.
steps: Under GLV-1, write 7 for S or small.
Under GLV-1, write 8 for M or medium.
Under GLV-1, write 9 for L or large.
Under GLV-1, write 10 for XL.
Under GLV-1, write 11 for XXL or 2XL.
Under GLV-1, when the value is written as size n, write n.

cut_level.written_form: Write the cut level as Cut A through Cut F, or mark an unconvertible level with CHECK: followed by the original text.
cut_level.not_listed: Write CHECK: followed by a space and the original text.
steps: Under GLV-2, for an EN 388 code such as 4X43D, take the fifth character and write the corresponding cut level, such as Cut D.
Under GLV-2, write Cut C for ISO cut C or cut C.
Under GLV-2, write CHECK: followed by a space and the original text for an old numeric level or an ANSI level.
exceptions: Mark an old numeric level or an ANSI level with CHECK: followed by the original text because there is no reliable conversion.

glove_material.written_form: Write the glove material as the corresponding canonical picklist value.
glove_material.not_listed: Write CHECK: followed by a space and the original text.
steps: Under GLV-3, write Nitrile for nitrile.
Under GLV-3, write Latex for latex or natural rubber.
Under GLV-3, write Neoprene for neoprene or chloroprene.
Under GLV-3, write Leather for leather, cowhide, or goatskin.
Under GLV-3, write HPPE for Dyneema, HPPE, or UHMWPE.
Under GLV-3, write Aramid for Kevlar, aramid, or para-aramid.
Under GLV-3, write PVC for PVC.

coating.written_form: Write the coating as the corresponding canonical picklist value.
coating.not_listed: Write CHECK: followed by a space and the original text.
steps: Under GLV-4, write Nitrile Palm for sandy nitrile, nitrile palm, or foam nitrile.
Under GLV-4, write PU Palm for PU coated palm or polyurethane palm.
Under GLV-4, write Latex Crinkle for crinkle latex.
Under GLV-4, write None for uncoated or none.

cuff_length.written_form: Write the cuff length as a whole number followed by one space and mm.
steps: Under GLV-5, convert inches to millimetres by multiplying by 25.4.
Round the result to a whole millimetre.
Write the result as a number followed by one space and mm.

impact_protection.written_form: Write the value as Yes or No.
impact_protection.not_listed: Write CHECK: followed by a space and the original text.
steps: (GLV-6) Write Yes when the input indicates a TPR back, impact, or an EN 388 'P' marking.
(GLV-6) Write No when the input does not indicate impact protection and the value can be determined from the closed list.
